title: PCSO Lotto Results: 2 bettors split P390.3-million Grand Lotto jackpot
summary: Two bettors will split the P390.3-million jackpot of the Grand Lotto 6/55 on Saturday, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) said.

blocks.text: Two bettors will split the P390.3-million jackpot of the Grand Lotto 6/55 on Saturday, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) said.
The 9 p.m. draw yielded the winning combination 21-04-29-08-26-09, with a prize of P390,356,981.96. The winning tickets were purchased in Pangasinan and Iloilo.
Meanwhile, two players will also split the 6D Lotto jackpot worth P4,883,976.
No one won the Lotto 6/42 jackpot, which stood at P10 million. —VBL, GMA News
